title: Chapter 1350
text:
In the Supercluster Alliance's joint conference room, many leaders were having a heated discussion.

Ever since the three Universal Civilizations announced the universal war mobilization, the leaders of the various civilizations had put down their other work and treated it as their top priority. They actively asked the three Universal Civilizations about the situation of the foreign enemy.

However, due to the importance of this matter, there were too many civilizations that were eager to find out more information. The three Universal Civilizations only gave a unified reply, briefly explaining the situation of the information entanglement. They claimed that they wanted to control the number of people who knew about it and said that it was not convenient to disclose the enemy's information for the time being. Therefore, the other civilizations knew almost nothing about the enemy.

However, even if some civilizations were usually dissatisfied with the three Universal Civilizations, they would still follow the instructions of the three Universal Civilizations and cooperate with the strategic deployment when facing an external war.

After all, the three Universal Civilizations were the supreme rulers, and their determination to protect the safety of the explored universe was unquestionable. At the same time, they were also the pillars of the galactic society. The various civilizations did not object to the three Universal Civilizations having unified command during wartime. Even the Supercluster Alliance did not dare have any objections.

A Supercluster leader knocked on the table and said loudly, "The invasion of a foreign civilization is not small.

For some reason, the three Universal Civilizations did not reveal the enemy's background. However, for them to make such a big fuss, it's obvious that they have met a strong enemy. "

"According to the attitude of the three Universal Civilizations, it's most likely a mature Universal Civilization this time. It's not something those natives can compare to," another guessed.

Everyone's expressions were rather heavy. This was not the first time the explored universe had dealt with an unknown civilization. In history, the development of new Star Fields would occasionally happen. The most recent example was the development of the Flickering World, and the Kunde Race war was similar. However, the natives and the Universal Civilizations were worlds apart, and the intensity of the war was on a completely different level.

The Universal Civilizations in the unexplored universe were basically the overlords of an area. This was not a small fight when fighting the natives but an equal galactic war. They no longer had a 100% chance of winning like when teaching the natives a lesson, and the galactic society had a chance of being destroyed.

The three Universal Civilizations had adopted a defensive posture in their base camp, so they were obviously not the ones who took the initiative to attack. There was a high chance that they were the ones being invaded. This made the leaders of the Supercluster Civilizations feel that something was wrong. No one wanted to start a war in their own territory. That way, even if they won, their territory would suffer huge losses. However, the three Universal Civilizations had adopted a defensive strategy, which meant that they were likely at a disadvantage, causing them to only be able to resist the invasion passively.

"The three Universal Civilizations' conservative strategy has exposed their lack of confidence. We should prepare a way out. If the three Universal Civilizations become losers, we have to think of a way to protect our civilization."

The leader of the Star Arc Sect said solemnly.

In the eyes of these superiors, nothing was inevitable. They would never believe that the three Universal Civilizations would never be defeated or destroyed. They had to consider every possibility and plan ahead.

"It's a pity that the three Universal Civilizations don't disclose information about this foreign enemy. We can't analyze their social structure, political orientation, and attitude …" Someone shook their head.

"It seems that we can only learn about this foreign civilization when the war starts. Then, we can make a decision based on the actual situation. Before that, we can only arrange the tinder warehouse."

The Starstreak Leader said.

After discussing for a while, one of the three kings of Modo suddenly spoke in a low voice.

"Speaking of which, this might be a chance for us to break the deadlock."

Hearing this, the eyes of the leaders of the Supercluster flickered.

They stayed in the explored universe, and their development had always been restricted by the three Universal Civilizations. Only external forces could break the balance. Their previous attempt at the Flickering World had failed, and although the Beyond Grade A Association had potential, it did not seem to be of much use now. However, external enemies were the biggest variable, and it was a good opportunity to change the situation.

The Star Arc Leader pinched his chin and slowly said,

"The most ideal situation is for the three Universal Civilizations and the foreign civilization to both be heavily injured. We can take over and rule the galactic society.

Of course, they will be on guard against us. If this path doesn't work, we can also retreat while the war is going on. The three Universal Civilizations won't have the strength to stop us then. We can take our civilization and migrate to a distant area, become the new rulers, eat resources, and develop freely. We won't be restricted and suppressed like today. "

Everyone's eyes lit up, and they were a little tempted.

As the saying went, one would rather be the head of a chicken than the tail of a phoenix. The Supercluster Alliance had been in second place for too long, and they were beaten by the three Universal Civilizations every day. If there was no external interference, they would never have a chance to turn the tables and would always be inferior to the three Universal Civilizations.

If they could get rid of the restrictions, a great migration could be a choice.

This time, the Star Arc Leader changed the topic.

"However, we don't have any information about the enemy now, so it's not suitable for us to make a decision … The three Universal Civilizations will most likely be on guard against us, forcing us to be the main force to reduce our strength and make us lose our threat. Therefore, we still have to see how the war goes."

The leaders nodded with subtle expressions.

Currently, the enemy had yet to attack, so it was naturally impossible for the various civilizations to unite. Selfishness was inevitable.

…

War had always been sudden, and the announcement of the three Universal Civilizations spread throughout the galaxy, shocking the players.

"Suddenly, there's going to be a war? I haven't even brushed my teeth yet! "

"Didn't they say that the main storyline was the rise of a Beyond Grade A country? Why did it suddenly become a galactic war?"

"Tsk, I got the main storyline wrong again. I really can't guess this version!"

"Actually, all of this can be traced. It's just that the level of intelligence we have is not high enough, so we can't get the inside story. We can only analyze the surface."

A large number of players on the forums were shocked, but after the shock, most of them quickly became excited.

War? That's good! I can participate in the main storyline again!

As a group that wished for the world to be in chaos, the players welcomed war. After the three Universal Civilizations and the association became good friends again, many players could only operate the black markets to farm daily items. Although they were very free, they did not have a main storyline goal, so they were more or less bored.

Now that a universal war was about to break out, perhaps the largest war they had seen so far, most of the players could not wait.

At this time, Han Xiao also issued a conscription order to the army players, summoning all the combat-ready soldiers of the army to the Flickering World on standby.

Under Black Star's call, the tens of millions of army players almost all responded, dropping the black market missions in their hands and gathering toward Black Star Palace from all over the world.

…

Flickering World, Dawn Star Cluster, border stargate station.

Civilian spaceships of various styles lined up in front of the stargate. Under the supervision of the Red Empire fleet, they maintained order and entered the stargate in batches. These were all galactic residents who responded to the migration and were leaving the Flickering World on a large scale.

Basically, all the galactic travel companies spontaneously assisted in the migration, mobilizing their ships to transport batch after batch of galactic residents out of the border. They responded to the call and also took the opportunity to make a fortune with the soaring demand for flights.

Currently, the galactic flights did not consider comfort, only passenger capacity. Unless they chose the VIP cabin that was many times more expensive, they could not expect to receive any special treatment.

In a large travel spaceship, countless galactic residents squeezed in the cabin hall. One could see all kinds of races there. These were all ordinary passengers, most of whom were chatting with their companions. There were many worried people, and the hall was noisy.

"The storms have been too frequent recently. Those higher-ups have been causing trouble, making us restless," a Universe Human could not help but complain.

A person beside him had a dissatisfied expression and said angrily, "Who said it isn't? Some time ago, the three Universal Civilizations were in a confrontation with the Beyond Grade A Association. I thought something big was going to happen, and it was finally resolved. Now, there's going to be a war.

"Since it has already happened, let's not complain so much." A well-dressed passenger sighed and said, "I only hope that this migration to the inner Star Field can guarantee our safety."

"As long as the three Universal Civilizations can stop the enemy in the border Star Field, we shouldn't have to worry. No matter how fierce the battle is, it won't be able to threaten us," another passenger said.

"It's hard to say. In the past, when we encountered foreign civilizations, the three Universal Civilizations did not let us migrate on a large scale. The enemy this time is probably very strong. I hope the three Universal Civilizations can be more reliable. Otherwise, the inner Star Fields won't be safe," someone said worriedly.

Everyone in the cabin was anxious, and the more they talked, the more worried they became.

Other than personal safety concerns, many people were also worried about their daily lives.

"The people in the border Star Fields have all migrated to the inner Star Fields. It should be crowded, and daily necessities will be more scarce. The prices will definitely rise …"

"Sigh, it wasn't easy for me to save up some money. I don't know how long it can last. I hope my job opportunities won't be affected. As long as I don't go to the frontlines, I'm willing to do any work."

Many passengers sighed.

At this time, something suddenly happened outside the window, attracting everyone's attention.

There was a long queue in front of the stargate, and the stargate nearby was deserted. However, at this time, fleets suddenly sailed out of the stargate and arrived in the Flickering World. The armor of the ships had the symbols of different Beyond Grade A organizations.

The next moment, these fleets turned into dense streams of light and headed in the opposite direction of the refugee fleet, heading toward the war zone.

"Those are the fleets of the Beyond Grade A Association?"

The passengers watched as the fleet disappeared from their sight, and the expressions of some of them suddenly became strange.

Among the refugees, there was no lack of galactic residents who had criticized the association online during the confrontation between the three Universal Civilizations and the association. When they saw this scene, they had mixed feelings.

…

Unexplored universe, interception zone.

A large number of mechanical strongholds were lined up in the starry sky, and the orbit formed by the Space Stabilization Anchor extended out, covering the route of the World Tree exploration team.

The construction efficiency of the three Universal Civilizations was astonishing. In just a few days, they had formed the prototype of the defense circle, forming a war zone here as the frontline to intercept the World Tree.

In the past few days, the three Universal Civilizations had been laying space stabilization tracks along the exploration team's route all day long, and the range was getting larger and larger. They had already discovered that the World Tree had tried to create wormholes in different locations many times, but they were all interfered with by the Space Stabilization Anchor and ultimately failed.

In the temporary base, Simon and the other commanders stayed in the Battle Staff Room and discussed softly in front of the tactical star map. Han Xiao and many Beyond Grade As listened from the side.

After the meeting, Han Xiao brought Kasuyi, Kant, and a dozen other Beyond Grade As to the interception zone. They sat down while understanding the current situation.

There were many territories of Beyond Grade A organizations in the Flickering World, and they were already preparing for war. There were many officers, so there was no need for the leaders of the organizations to keep an eye on them.

Other than the members of the association, there were also many direct Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations. They were also here to prevent the World Tree from sending Beyond Grade As over.

"According to the statistics, the other party has already tried to open a wormhole channel five times. The coordinates are getting farther and farther away, and the last time, they are already close to the edge of the space stabilization orbit."

Simon pointed at the star map and said solemnly,

"The coordinates chosen by the other party next time should be very far away, and it might be outside our observation range … The defense circle is not complete yet. Black Star, we still need your help."

"I'll try my best."

Han Xiao nodded.

Laying down the space stabilization orbit could only delay the teleportation location of the World Tree a little, but it could not cover the route left behind by the exploration team over countless years. As long as the World Tree moved the teleportation coordinates far away, it would be able to throw the new exploration team over sooner or later.

If the new World Tree exploration team was outside their observation range, it would be more troublesome. The other party could take a big detour, and the three Universal Civilizations' defense circle had not been completely built yet, so the probability of intercepting them was limited. The best way now was to rely on Destiny's Child's intelligence channels to locate the location of the subsequent exploration team and intercept them to prevent any fish from escaping the net.

The premise was that the sub-bodies of the World Tree had this information, or else Destiny's Child would not be able to obtain it. However, this channel was very hidden, and the World Tree should not be aware of the problem. They would still use the power of the Diviners to solve the problems for the exploration team.

Beep beep beep …

At this moment, Han Xiao's communicator suddenly rang.

The room immediately fell silent. Everyone stopped talking and looked at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao took out his communicator and looked at it. It was a message from Oathkeeper.

After reading the content, his eyes flashed, and he pondered.

"The World Tree has successfully opened the wormhole, and the new batch of exploration teams has arrived. They are four days away from the furthest space stabilization node … Everyone, we have to fight the other party."

Hearing this, everyone's pupils constricted.

Although they were mentally prepared, they were still feeling heavy when they officially fought the World Tree army. Only Han Xiao could treat it calmly in the room.
